input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves User, Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for account repository, accounts, load balancer configuration properties. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use account repository capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
